entries.desc: story_advance DONE redirects the final activity heartbeat to the main repo when the starting worktree has been removed.

evidence.note: assertPostDoneHeartbeatLandsInMainAfterWorktreeRemoval runs story_advance DONE from the story worktree with KOALA_PROJECT_ROOT pinned to that worktree, then asserts main .koala/activity.jsonl contains the successful story_advance record.

entries.desc: A DONE command invoked from the story worktree does not recreate .worktrees/<storyId> after cleanup.

evidence.note: DONE success path and B-da5b regression both assert the removed .worktrees/<storyId> path, its .koala dir, and ghost activity.jsonl stay absent after activity logging.

entries.desc: The test fails if a ghost worktree shell containing runtime activity logs appears after DONE cleanup.

evidence.note: The regression pins the old ghost-path condition by setting KOALA_PROJECT_ROOT to the worktree; the test only passes when writeLog uses the pre-captured durable main-root fallback instead of recreating or losing a ghost worktree log.
